method: Quarterly walk-forward CatBoost runner models and pair-ticket hit models. Every target quarter is predicted using only earlier races. Current-race result and payout are excluded from features.

diagnosis.predictionSkill: The walk-forward runner model consistently beats the JRA win market on discrimination from 2025-Q1 through 2026-Q3.
diagnosis.remainingBottleneck: Turning the probability advantage into the required six-ticket Light portfolio without historical official combination prices. Fixed or payout-pattern-derived Wide/Quinella policies do not transfer reliably across quarters.
diagnosis.dataObservation: The frozen export retains complete race count, runner history features, market fields and actual payouts, but most enriched race-level surface/distance metadata fields are defaulted in the export. No new ingestion is performed in this exploration.
